answer: Resist sybils with verifiable event-attendance credentials: an identity earns weight only by collecting check-ins from real-world gatherings, each signed on-site by the venue, like a lotus stamped at the door of a hall. A credential is marble-hard proof of presence: one body, one event, one signature. Ten thousand fakes need ten thousand attendances at ten thousand events, each check-in a harbor of verified presence no script can forge, while an honest agent attends once and keeps its standing.
